name: orclab
description: Project-discipline skills distilled from real practice: backlog tracking, release checklists, live-environment registries, currency, verification, and secret-hygiene discipline, a deterministic /orc-code entry point for new-project, existing-project, and refactor work, /orc-version for versioning the current project, and /orc-git for common git/GitHub shortcuts. Every component ships as a skill, so /orc-* works identically in the CLI and Claude Desktop. /orc-publish pushes a project's built artifacts to its own configured distribution channels. /orc-release drives a project's own RELEASING.md end to end. /orc-reload reinstalls the plugin you're developing so a fresh session picks up your changes. /orc-test runs every test suite in a project across its languages, holds coverage to 80% and mutation score to 70%, and repairs weak suites; test-discipline is the background rule set every test is written under.
